title: Design System: Project Dossier — Midnight Campus HUD

display.purpose: Hero and chapter headings with high-impact Chinese and English numbering.

body.purpose: Long-form project explanations, feature facts and boundary documentation.

hud.purpose: Status labels, coordinates, code labels, navigation and system microcopy.

shadows.name: screen-panel

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#68F5FF; color:#050814; border:1px solid #68F5FF; padding:0 22px; min-height:52px; font:800 14px/1 sans-serif; clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 14px) 0,100% 14px,100% 100%,14px 100%,0 calc(100% - 14px)); transition:background .24s,color .24s,transform .24s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#050814; color:#68F5FF; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F4F7EF; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary source or alternate navigation action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background:transparent; color:#F4F7EF; border:1px solid rgba(218,229,255,.36); padding:0 22px; min-height:52px; font:800 14px/1 sans-serif; clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 14px) 0,100% 14px,100% 100%,14px 100%,0 calc(100% - 14px)); transition:background .24s,color .24s,border-color .24s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#68F5FF; color:#050814; border-color:#68F5FF; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #68F5FF; outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-project { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr; background:#0C1224; color:#F4F7EF; border-block:1px solid rgba(218,229,255,.36); overflow:hidden; } .ds-shot { min-height:340px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#080D1D,#111A31); color:#68F5FF; font:800 13px/1 sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; border-right:1px solid rgba(218,229,255,.36); } .ds-copy { padding:48px; } .ds-copy small { color:#68F5FF; font:800 12px/1 sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; } .ds-copy h2 { margin:16px 0; font-size:46px; line-height:.98; } .ds-copy em { color:#68F5FF; font-style:normal; } .ds-copy p { color:#B4BED6; line-height:1.7; max-width:42ch; } .ds-btn { margin-top:24px; background:#68F5FF; color:#050814; border:0; padding:14px 18px; font-weight:800; }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: A factual system state, never an invented metric.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #68F5FF; color:#68F5FF; background:#050814; font:800 12px/1 sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; }

components.css: .ds-boundary { background:#111A31; color:#F4F7EF; border:1px solid #FF405D; clip-path:polygon(0 0,94% 0,100% 6%,100% 100%,6% 100%,0 94%); } .ds-boundary header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:13px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(218,229,255,.18); color:#B4BED6; font:800 12px/1 sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-boundary header b { color:#FF405D; } .ds-boundary h2 { margin:0; padding:28px 24px 18px; font-size:34px; line-height:1.08; } .ds-boundary h2 em { color:#FF405D; font-style:normal; } .ds-boundary ul { margin:0; padding:0 24px 24px; } .ds-boundary li { list-style:none; padding:16px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(218,229,255,.18); } .ds-boundary p { margin:5px 0 0; color:#B4BED6; font-size:13px; }

narrative.overview: An original midnight campus dossier that combines tactical HUD structure with high-contrast editorial typography. Color, clips and motion organize project evidence; they never replace it.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight-blue base with selective electronic accents
One authored diagonal reveal rather than continuous spectacle

rules.name: Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Fluorescent colors designate state and interaction, not ambient decoration.

rules.name: Screen-Not-Glass Rule
rules.body: Use panels, borders, cropping and offset shadows; do not use decorative glassmorphism.

dos: Do keep the experience/source action visible in the first viewport.
Do label demo data, reconstructed interfaces and pending experience codes.
Do preserve keyboard focus and reduced-motion alternatives.
donts: Don't use Persona 3 characters, logos, fonts or screenshots.
Don't invent users, revenue, retention, awards or operations.
Don't add autoplay marquees, perpetual flicker or decorative colored glows.
